organizations.name: Bandidos Motorcycle Club
about: Bandidos Motorcycle Club began in March 1966, according to the club's published history.
The club uses red and gold colors, which its history links to founder Don Chambers' service in the U.S. Marine Corps.
The club's history records its first chapter outside the United States in Sydney, Australia, in August 1983.

sources.notes: Public worldwide homepage advertises USA region but scraped page and HTML expose no destination links or US chapter roster.

Official European organization history: 'In March of 1966, The Bandidos Motorcycleclub was born'; red and gold chosen because US Marine Corps colors; first overseas chapter chartered August 1983 in Sydney.

Public homepage application script has USA region object with link https://www.bandidosmcunitedstates.com. Destination inaccessible: Firecrawl HTTPS tunnel errors, HTTP all-engines failure; direct curl CONNECT tunnel 403. No indexed site results.

coverageNotes: A current, retrievable U.S. city-level chapter directory was not established during this review. Historical news reports and unrelated Maps results were not used to create current listings.
City-level chapter coverage is pending. This does not mean the organization has no chapters.

organizations.name: Hells Angels Motorcycle Club
about: The Hells Angels trace their founding to March 17, 1948, in California's Fontana and San Bernardino area.
The club calls its local groups charters and publishes an international directory, including a dedicated United States roster.

sources.notes: Official live USA roster; names paired with state-specific patch image paths and charter URLs. Publicly listed does not establish a public clubhouse.
Official history states March 17th 1948 founding in Fontana/San Bernardino and identifies Berdoo with San Bernardino.

coverageNotes: This directory includes charters whose published names and state associations identify a city or town. County, regional and nomadic charters are omitted when a city could not be established.
A charter's listed city is not a confirmed clubhouse address or an invitation to visit. Source review dates do not establish current activity.

organizations.name: Outlaws Motorcycle Club
about: The Outlaws Motorcycle Club traces its beginnings to McCook, Illinois, in 1935.
The club's history records the formation of the American Outlaws Association in 1965 and its first chapter outside the United States in Canada in 1977.
Its official worldwide directory organizes United States chapters by state alongside chapters in other countries.

sources.notes: Official history: McCook establishment in 1935; AOA formed January 1, 1965; first chapter outside USA in Canada, 1977.

Official worldwide roster; footer Last Update October-19-2026. All included rows directly listed under USA and state. City labels are chapter associations, not verified clubhouse municipalities. No street addresses provided.

coverageNotes: These are city-associated chapters listed in the club's worldwide roster, which displayed an October 19, 2026 update date when reviewed. Regional, ambiguous and prospective entries are omitted.
Distinct named chapters within the same city remain separate. A chapter name identifies its listed area, not a verified clubhouse address.
